raw: I felt sad when my old school was being demolished. They lowered the bell from the tower, and that’s the part I keep coming back to—the bell down out of its place. Then there were the chalkboards piled beside the front gate. Chalkboards make you think of classrooms, but there they were by the gate, just a pile of things being taken out. It was strange seeing the school like that. I knew it was being demolished, but seeing those familiar parts separated from the building made it feel real. It wasn’t just a building to me. It was my old school.
